method.method_draft: Label the strip of small triangles from left to right. From the image, read that the leftmost bottom horizontal side is blue, the first top horizontal side is green, the middle bottom horizontal side is marked x, the next bottom horizontal side to the right is blue, and the far-right top horizontal side is green. Use the text rule that every triangle must contain exactly one red, one green, and one blue side, and that a shared side has the same colour for both adjacent triangles. On the left pair of adjacent triangles, the shared slanted side between a triangle with bottom blue and a triangle with top green must be red, so the other slanted side of the top-green triangle is blue. On the right pair, by the same reasoning, the relevant slanted side of the blue-bottom triangle is green. Now focus on the two central triangles around x. The triangle containing x already has a blue slanted side, so its other two sides, including x, must be red and green. The adjacent central triangle to its right already has a green slanted side, so their shared slanted side must be red or blue. Combining these restrictions forces the shared slanted side to be red, leaving x green.
